properties.cad_note: CAD polylines without exported vertex coordinates remain unavailable from the CSV; their layer/object metadata exists in the source CSV but cannot be converted to exact GeoJSON geometry.

cad_full_extraction.note: Renderable geometry is preserved without compression or invented coordinates. Polyline records whose vertices were not exported are retained below as CAD metadata.
cad_full_extraction.stair_geometry_status: complete line/polyline geometry from Civil 3D MAPEXPORT

source_validation.note: All 387 geometric stair/step entities in the bound General Layout Xref are represented in this GeoJSON. The remaining stair-layer DXF entity is an empty anonymous INSERT with no drawable geometry and is intentionally omitted.

vegetation_source_validation.source_kind: direct XREF_MON_SFT_SHRUBS drawing exported as DXF
vegetation_source_validation.note: Vegetation polygons were rebuilt from the direct native shrub/groundcover source drawing instead of the nested bound-Xref copy. Existing stairs, trees, paths, structures, water and other GIS features were preserved. No Z values were fabricated.

vegetation_classification_update.reason: The native softscape drawing stores many grass/low-planting species in species-specific 00-HATCH_* layers rather than only in the dedicated Lawn layer. Those low-planting species are now classified as GroundCover so the 3D app can render them.

complete_softscape_update.approach: Every recoverable planted HATCH from the native softscape source is now included as a GroundCover planting-surface polygon. Shrub species also keep a separate shrub overlay so the map can render shrubs above a continuous planted ground surface instead of leaving empty/black gaps.
complete_softscape_update.cad_color_note: Each planting-surface feature includes cad_aci_color and cad_color_hex from the original AutoCAD layer so species/surface colors can be reproduced by the renderer.

all_cad_objects_source.signage_interpretation: The source layer named 00-Signage contains planting callouts/plant symbols. MULTILEADER text is preserved exactly as sign_text. No standard road-regulatory messages such as No Parking, Stop, or Entry/Exit were found, so no regulatory sign graphics were fabricated.

autocad_color_update.description: CAD display colors were copied from each native AutoCAD entity. Priority: entity true color, entity ACI, layer true color, then layer ACI. GroundCover surfaces can therefore reproduce the color groups visible in the source Civil 3D drawing.

exact_cad_color_rendering.notes: Features that have a native CAD display color now expose render_color_hex. The paired Map.vue uses unlit materials, NoToneMapping, no scene lights and sRGB output so these source colors are not shifted by Three.js lighting.
